answer_1.quote: In this work, we study the degree to which neural sequence-to-sequence (S2S) models exhibit fine-grained controllability when performing natural language generation (NLG) from a meaning representation (MR).

answer_2.quote: For automatic quality measures, we report BLEU and ROUGE-L scores. Additionally, we use the matching rules to automatically annotate the attribute-value spans of the model generated utterances... we compute the semantic error rate (SER)

answer_4.quote: In our final experiment, we had human evaluators rank the 100 outputs... The annotators were asked to rank outputs by their naturalness/fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Please rank the utterances according to their naturalness (i.e. fluency and/or degree to which you believe they were written by a native English speaker).
